title: Sockets
statementMd:
The ICM ACPC World Finals is coming! Unfortunately, the organizers of the competition were so busy preparing tasks that totally missed an important technical point — the organization of electricity supplement for all the participants workstations.

There are $*n*$ computers for participants, the $*i*$-th of which has power equal to positive integer $*p*_{*i*}$. At the same time there are $*m*$ sockets available, the $*j*$-th of which has power euqal to positive integer $*s*_{*j*}$. It is possible to connect the $*i*$-th computer to the $*j*$-th socket if and only if their powers are the same: $*p*_{*i*} = *s*_{*j*}$. It is allowed to connect no more than one computer to one socket. Thus, if the powers of all computers and sockets are distinct, then no computer can be connected to any of the sockets.

In order to fix the situation professor Puch Williams urgently ordered a wagon of adapters — power splitters. Each adapter has one plug and one socket with a voltage divider between them. After plugging an adapter to a socket with power $*x*$, the power on the adapter's socket becomes equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f12f73ab57d327f2f2cb7c8de54e8e6e246f6b2e.png), it means that it is equal to the socket's power divided by two with rounding up, for example ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/76bfa25c99d0b55a7a771e94e81663797271f0c7.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6e981410b6288893640ae21ef007a1fd60c8ab1f.png).

Each adapter can be used only once. It is possible to connect several adapters in a chain plugging the first to a socket. For example, if two adapters are plugged one after enother to a socket with power $10$, it becomes possible to connect one computer with power $3$ to this socket.

The organizers should install adapters so that it will be possible to supply with electricity the maximum number of computers $*c*$ at the same time. If there are several possible connection configurations, they want to find the one that uses the minimum number of adapters $*u*$ to connect $*c*$ computers.

Help organizers calculate the maximum number of connected computers $*c*$ and the minimum number of adapters $*u*$ needed for this.

The wagon of adapters contains enough of them to do the task. It is guaranteed that it's possible to connect at least one computer.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of computers and the number of sockets.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the powers of the computers.

The third line contains $*m*$ integers $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the power of the sockets.

## Output

In the first line print two numbers $*c*$ and $*u*$ — the maximum number of computers which can at the same time be connected to electricity and the minimum number of adapters needed to connect $*c*$ computers.

In the second line print $*m*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ equals the number of adapters orginizers need to plug into the $*i*$-th socket. The sum of all $*a*_{*i*}$ should be equal to $*u*$.

In third line print $*n*$ integers $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$), where the $*b*_{*j*}$-th equals the number of the socket which the $*j*$-th computer should be connected to. $*b*_{*j*} = 0$ means that the $*j*$-th computer should not be connected to any socket. All $*b*_{*j*}$ that are different from $0$ should be distinct. The power of the $*j*$-th computer should be equal to the power of the socket $*b*_{*j*}$ after plugging in $*a*_{*b*_{*j*}}$ adapters. The number of non-zero $*b*_{*j*}$ should be equal to $*c*$.

If there are multiple answers, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

ICM ACPC 世界总决赛即将举行！然而，比赛组织者忙于准备题目，完全忽略了一个重要的技术问题——为所有参赛者的工作站提供电力。

有 $*n*$ 台参赛者使用的计算机，其中第 $*i*$ 台计算机的功率为正整数 $*p*_{*i*}$。同时有 $*m*$ 个可用插座，其中第 $*j*$ 个插座的功率为正整数 $*s*_{*j*}$。当且仅当两者的功率相同时，才可以将第 $*i*$ 台计算机连接到第 $*j*$ 个插座，即满足 $*p*_{*i*} = *s*_{*j*}$。每个插座至多连接一台计算机。因此，如果所有计算机和插座的功率都各不相同，那么没有任何计算机可以连接到插座上。

为了解决这一问题，Puch Williams 教授紧急订购了一车适配器——功率分配器。每个适配器有一个插头和一个插座，两者之间带有分压器。将一个适配器插入功率为 $*x*$ 的插座后，适配器上的插座功率会变为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f12f73ab57d327f2f2cb7c8de54e8e6e246f6b2e.png)，也就是说，它等于原插座功率除以二并向上取整。例如 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/76bfa25c99d0b55a7a771e94e81663797271f0c7.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6e981410b6288893640ae21ef007a1fd60c8ab1f.png)。

每个适配器只能使用一次。可以将多个适配器首尾相连，形成一条链，并将第一个适配器插入插座。例如，如果依次将两个适配器插入功率为 $10$ 的插座，就可以将一台功率为 $3$ 的计算机连接到该插座。

组织者需要安装适配器，使得能够同时为最多数量的计算机 $*c*$ 供电。如果有多种连接方案，他们希望在连接 $*c*$ 台计算机的前提下，使用最少数量的适配器 $*u*$。

请帮助组织者计算最多能够连接的计算机数量 $*c*$，以及实现这一数量所需的最少适配器数量 $*u*$。

适配器的数量足够完成任务。保证至少可以连接一台计算机。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 200 000$），分别表示计算机和插座的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示计算机的功率。

第三行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*s*_{1}, *s*_{2}, ..., *s*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示插座的功率。

## 输出格式

第一行输出两个数 $*c*$ 和 $*u*$，分别表示最多能够同时连接到电源的计算机数量，以及连接 $*c*$ 台计算机所需的最少适配器数量。

第二行输出 $*m*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*m*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示组织者需要插入第 $*i*$ 个插座的适配器数量。所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的总和应等于 $*u*$。

第三行输出 $*n*$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$），其中 $*b*_{*j*}$ 表示第 $*j*$ 台计算机应连接的插座编号。$*b*_{*j*} = 0$ 表示第 $*j*$ 台计算机不连接任何插座。所有不为 $0$ 的 $*b*_{*j*}$ 应当互不相同。第 $*j*$ 台计算机的功率应等于将 $*a*_{*b*_{*j*}}$ 个适配器插入插座 $*b*_{*j*}$ 后该插座的功率。不为零的 $*b*_{*j*}$ 的数量应等于 $*c*$。

如果有多种答案，输出任意一种即可。
